scopeChangeReason: B-a745 is Rollout Story 1 of the dynamic validation tiers plan and must not shrink any validation set or touch any lifecycle gate. The protected files are the gate and final-assurance owners this Story consumes but must never modify: the state machine and its guards, DONE-required validation, the shared freshness readers, and the delivery check. evidence-freshness.ts in particular is protected deliberately - the Story input collector must CONSUME its rename-aware readers, and any edit there would mean the collector re-derived changed files instead of reusing the single owner. The excluded paths are the plan document itself, which story B-ccf4 owns and which must not be copied into this branch, and the noncanonical smoke discovery manifests, which the test-runner consolidation plan forbids using as membership authority.

acknowledgements.reason: Registering ONE new read-only command (validation_plan, CHK-005) requires three cross-registries beyond the four files CHK-005 declared, and every one of them fails closed rather than defaulting, so the command is unusable without them. config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS: every phase refuses the command until it is listed. cli/activity-policy.ts READ_ONLY_COMMANDS: without the entry a command that is contractually read-only would write an activity heartbeat, which would contradict the read-only guarantee this Story ships and would break the store-equality fixture. process-fact-levels.ts: the lifecycle-registry-contract check fails with 'command validation_plan is in the registry command dimension but has no process-fact lifecycle level entry'; validation_plan is registered L0 because it consumes no gate evidence and produces none. These are not new capability and not scope growth: each is a single row naming the same command CHK-005 already declares, and none changes behaviour for any other command. The scope contract was written from plan.md's Files sections before this cross-registry requirement was known; it is recorded here rather than by silently widening the contract, so the extension stays auditable. No protected file was touched.
